records.name: Webcam Snapshot Image Reference
records.description: Reference to the raw webcam snapshot image captured on the endpoint (local cache path and/or uploaded object key).

records.name: Webcam Snapshot Capture DateTime (UTC)
records.description: Timestamp when the webcam snapshot was captured on the endpoint (UTC).

records.name: Webcam Snapshot Capture Unix Time
records.description: Unix/Epoch timestamp when the webcam snapshot was captured on the endpoint.

records.name: Webcam Device Name (Actual Used)
records.description: Actual webcam device name used for capture (may differ from Default Webcam in profile).

records.name: Webcam Snapshot UUID
records.description: Unique identifier for the webcam snapshot instance; typically correlated to EdgeScanUUID for the same scan cycle.

records.name: Webcam Snapshot Object Detections (Array)
records.description: List of objects detected in the webcam snapshot with confidence and bounding box.

records.name: Object Detection Type
records.description: Detected object category label (Tier-1/Tier-2).

records.name: Object Detection Confidence
records.description: Model confidence score for the detected object (0.0–1.0).

records.name: Object Detection Bounding Box
records.description: Bounding box for detected object in normalized coordinates (x,y,width,height) or pixel coordinates depending on implementation.

records.name: Webcam Snapshot Face Detection (Object)
records.description: Face detection output for the webcam snapshot (presence + confidence + optional vectors/artifacts).

records.name: Face Detected Bool
records.description: True if a face was detected in the webcam snapshot.

records.name: Face Vectors Reference
records.description: Reference to stored embedding vector(s) or face feature artifact produced during processing.

records.name: Face Detection Confidence
records.description: Confidence score for detected face (0.0–1.0).

records.name: Identity Match Result
records.description: Identity verification result artifact (match/no-match/unknown) produced by FBA or session identity confidence.

records.name: Screenshot Image Reference
records.description: Reference to the screenshot image captured on the endpoint (local cache and/or uploaded object key).

records.name: Screenshot Capture DateTime (UTC)
records.description: Timestamp when the screenshot was captured on the endpoint (UTC).

records.name: Screenshot Display Device Name
records.description: Display device identifier for the screenshot (e.g., DISPLAY1, DISPLAY2).

records.name: Screenshot Display Index
records.description: Zero-based display index for the screenshot within the endpoint's active display set.

records.name: Screenshot Split Enabled
records.description: True if screenshots were split per-display during capture/upload.

records.name: Screenshot Compression Enabled
records.description: True if screenshot images were compressed prior to upload.

records.name: Screenshot File Name
records.description: Filename of screenshot artifact produced by the endpoint agent.

records.name: Screen Recording Clip Reference
records.description: Reference to a screen recording clip (if screen recording is enabled) captured as evidence.

records.name: Validation Report Generated DateTime
records.description: Date/time when the Trendzact Full Validation Report was generated.

records.name: Validation: System Information Status
records.description: Overall status for the System Information validation test (PASS/FAIL).

records.name: Validation: System Information Duration (ms)
records.description: Execution time for the System Information validation test in milliseconds.

records.name: Validation: Username
records.description: Username detected during validation.

records.name: Validation: Local IP
records.description: Local IP detected during validation.

records.name: Validation: Public IP
records.description: Public IP detected during validation.

records.name: Validation: Latency (ms)
records.description: Measured network latency during validation (ms).

records.name: Validation: Bandwidth (Mbps)
records.description: Measured bandwidth during validation (Mbps).

records.name: Validation: Services & Auth Status
records.description: Overall status for the Trendzact Services & Auth validation test (PASS/FAIL).

records.name: Validation: Services & Auth Duration (ms)
records.description: Execution time for the Trendzact Services & Auth validation test in milliseconds.

records.name: Validation: Endpoints Reachable
records.description: Count of reachable endpoints during validation in the form reachable/total.

records.name: Validation: Authentication Status
records.description: Authentication test result status.

records.name: Validation: Authentication HTTP Status
records.description: HTTP status code returned by the authentication test.

records.name: Validation: File Upload Status
records.description: File upload test result status.

records.name: Validation: Monitor Spawn Debugger Status
records.description: Overall status for the Monitor Spawn Debugger validation test (PASS/FAIL).

records.name: Validation: Monitor Spawn Debugger Duration (ms)
records.description: Execution time for the Monitor Spawn Debugger validation test in milliseconds.

records.name: Validation: Network Endpoint Checks (Array)
records.description: Per-endpoint validation results including status, response time, and message.
